item.title: Governing the AGI Transformation through Technology Ecosystems: Global Power, Technology-Institutional Co-evolution, and Societal Impact
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites scholarly work on how technology ecosystems can effectively govern the transformation brought about by artificial general intelligence (AGI). The collection seeks to examine the interplay between technological advancement and institutional structures, with particular attention to questions of global power distribution and how societies will be impacted by these shifts.

Appel publié par Technology in Society. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
